Random spectral-dropout augmentation for masked-VAE training

Source: R/preprocess.R
spectral_dropout.Rd

For every input row, generates additional copies that simulate partial- coverage instruments by zeroing out the mask outside randomised cut-off wavelengths. Per OSSL v1.2, the realistic VisNIR cut-offs are 350, 400, 800, 1000, 1350 nm (corresponding to ASD, Foss, Bruker MPA, PerkinElmer, NeoSpectra); MIR cut-offs cluster around 600-700 cm-1.

Usage

spectral_dropout(
  X,
  wavegrid,
  sensor_type = c("visnir", "mir"),
  n_copies = 2L,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

X

Numeric matrix of preprocessed spectra (rows = samples, cols = bands)

wavegrid

Numeric vector of wavelength/wavenumber positions (length == ncol(X))

sensor_type

"visnir" or "mir" (controls realistic cut-off pool)

n_copies

How many augmented copies to generate per input row (in addition to the original full-coverage copy). Default 2.

seed

Optional RNG seed for reproducibility

Value

List with X (rbind of all copies) and mask (same shape, 0/1)
